name: After § 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 9b. Reiterates its strong condemnation of the 2011 NATO-led intervention in Libya, which it considers to have significantly contributed to enduring instability, insecurity and humanitarian suffering in the region; recalls that Mediterranean EU Member States have been disproportionately affected by the pressures resulting from destabilisation in the region; condemns the EU’s policy towards Libya, including its support for the Libyan coastguard, which is responsible for violations of human rights and continuous pushbacks;
